about: Thresholds and status groups for scripts/journey_flags.py, which turns the scenario x step x status cross-tab of the campaign event into per-step numbers and flags. Each key is explained under notes.

notes.delivered_statuses: Statuses that mean the message reached the inbox or phone.
notes.enqueued_statuses: Statuses that mean the message was handed to the sending provider. Email records enqueued; SMS and push record sent, with no delivered. The script takes the largest of them per step, so a step that records both isn't counted twice.
notes.held_back_statuses: Statuses where Bloomreach chose not to send: no consent, frequency policy, or an abort in the template.
notes.not_queued_statuses: Statuses where the message failed before it reached the provider, usually a template rendering error.
notes.bounce_statuses: Statuses where the provider tried and failed. Live projects use hard_bounced and soft_bounced; the older spellings are kept.
notes.engagement_statuses: Statuses recorded after delivery (opens, clicks, unsubscribes) or by weblayers. They are not part of reached or lost, and are not listed as unknown.
notes.min_reached: Steps that reached fewer customers' messages than this are listed but never flagged: their shares are noisy.
notes.lost_share_high: A step whose lost share (reached minus delivered, over reached) is at or above this is a high-severity flag.
notes.lost_share_medium: A step whose lost share is at or above this (but under lost_share_high) is a medium-severity flag.
notes.error_share_medium: A step whose errors (not queued plus bounces) are at or above this share of reached gets a medium flag, even when the lost share is low.
notes.drop_ratio: A step whose delivered count in the current period is at or below this fraction of the previous period's is flagged as a drop.
notes.drop_min_previous: The drop check only applies when the previous period delivered at least this many.
notes.lost_share_rise_points: A step whose lost share rose by at least this many percentage points against the previous period is flagged.
notes.top: How many flagged steps to list in the Markdown output; the rest are counted.
